instruction: I want to enable crossfade while switching songs in Music. Please help me navigate to the corresponding settings panel.
evaluator: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to get value of attribute "AXChildren" of scroll area 1 of group 1 of window 1 of (first application process whose frontmost is true)' 2>/dev/null | grep -q "checkbox Crossfade Songs" && echo "True" || echo "False"
